The ICmdHelper interface is not directly visible in the Commands/Services folder or nearby. Since ICmdHelper is a dependency of DotnetEfToolManager and is used to run commands and get output, I will create a mock for it in the test. The Logger is also injectable and can be mocked.

- Mocks ICmdHelper to simulate the tool not installed initially.
- Verifies that Logger.LogInformation is called with the expected messages when InstallDotnetEfTool is triggered.

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Services.Tests
{
    public class DotnetEfToolManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BeSureInstalledAsync_LogsInformationWhenInstalling()
        {
            // Arrange
            var cmdHelperMock = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<DotnetEfToolManager>>();

            // Simulate tool not installed initially
            cmdHelperMock.Setup(c => c.RunCmdAndGetOutput("dotnet tool list -g"))
                .Returns("some other tool");

            // We want to verify that RunCmd is called with install command
            cmdHelperMock.Setup(c => c.RunCmd("dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef"));

            var manager = new DotnetEfToolManager(cmdHelperMock.Object)
            {
                Logger = loggerMock.Object
            };

            // Act
            await manager.BeSureInstalledAsync();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "Installing dotnet-ef tool..."),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "dotnet-ef tool is installed."),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            cmdHelperMock.Verify(c => c.RunCmd("dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef"), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

        {
            public TestDotnetEfToolManager(ICmdHelper cmdHelper) : base(cmdHelper)

            }

            public bool InstallDotnetEfToolCalled { get; private set; }

            // Override InstallDotnetEfTool to avoid running actual command and to track call
            private new void InstallDotnetEfTool()
            {
                InstallDotnetEfToolCalled = true;
                Logger.LogInformation("Installing dotnet-ef tool...");
                Logger.LogInformation("dotnet-ef tool is installed.");
            }

            public new async Task BeSureInstalledAsync()
            {
                if (!IsDotNetEfToolInstalled())
                {
                    InstallDotnetEfTool();
                }
                await Task.CompletedTask;
            }

            public new bool IsDotNetEfToolInstalled()
            {
                return base.IsDotNetEfToolInstalled();
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeSureInstalledAsync_LogsInformationWhenInstalling()
        {
            // Arrange
            var cmdHelperMock = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<DotnetEfToolManager>>();

            // Simulate tool not installed initially
            cmdHelperMock.Setup(c => c.RunCmdAndGetOutput("dotnet tool list -g"))
                .Returns("some other tool");

            var manager = new TestDotnetEfToolManager(cmdHelperMock.Object)
            {
                Logger = loggerMock.Object
            };

            // Act
            await manager.BeSureInstalledAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.True(manager.InstallDotnetEfToolCalled);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "Installing dotnet-ef tool..."),

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "dotnet-ef tool is installed."),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, System.Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IsDotNetEfToolInstalled_ReturnsTrueWhenOutputContainsDotnetEf()
        {
            // Arrange
            var cmdHelperMock = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
            cmdHelperMock.Setup(c => c.RunCmdAndGetOutput("dotnet tool list -g"))
                .Returns("dotnet-ef some version");

            var manager = new DotnetEfToolManager(cmdHelperMock.Object);

            // Act
            var result = manager.IsDotNetEfToolInstalled();

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IsDotNetEfToolInstalled_ReturnsFalseWhenOutputDoesNotContainDotnetEf()
        {
            // Arrange
            var cmdHelperMock = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
            cmdHelperMock.Setup(c => c.RunCmdAndGetOutput("dotnet tool list -g"))

            var manager = new DotnetEfToolManager(cmdHelperMock.Object);

            // Act
            var result = manager.IsDotNetEfToolInstalled();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }
    }
